# Badge

A short label for a status, category or count, next to what it describes.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Accessible first</span> </p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A state people scan for in a list or table, or a small category label.
- **Not when:** A message people must read (alert or toast), or an action (a button).

Instead:

- [Alert](./alert.md): A message, not a label.
- [Button](./button.md): Something to press.

## How Accessible first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A status</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Badge with an icon and a word</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Color alone</div></div><div class="cap">Status must survive no color and a screen reader.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Shape of a status badge</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> radius.badge (rectangle)</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A pill</div></div><div class="cap">Clear shapes with a word inside.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The status is a word; color and icon add to it, never replace it. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add badge
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `badge/radius` | Badge corner radius. | `radius.badge` → `accessible-first.theme.base.radius.badge` → `radius.4` | same |
| `badge/padding-x` | Horizontal padding inside a badge. | `space.gap.tight` → `space.12` | same |
| `badge/font-size` | Badge label size. | `type.caption.font-size` → `font.size.16` | same |
| `badge/neutral/background` | Neutral badge fill. | `color.surface.sunken` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.surface.sunken` → `color.gray.light.100` | `color.surface.sunken` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.surface.sunken` → `color.gray.dark.100` |
| `badge/neutral/label` | Neutral badge label. | `color.text.secondary` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.text.secondary` → `color.gray.light.700` | `color.text.secondary` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.text.secondary` → `color.gray.dark.600` |
| `badge/info/background` | Info badge fill. | `color.status.info.subtle` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.status.info.subtle` → `color.teal.light.100` | `color.status.info.subtle` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.status.info.subtle` → `color.teal.dark.100` |
| `badge/info/label` | Info badge label. | `color.status.info.@` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.status.info.@` → `color.teal.light.700` | `color.status.info.@` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.status.info.@` → `color.teal.dark.700` |
| `badge/success/background` | Success badge fill. | `color.status.success.subtle` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.status.success.subtle` → `color.green.light.100` | `color.status.success.subtle` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.status.success.subtle` → `color.green.dark.100` |
| `badge/success/label` | Success badge label. | `color.status.success.@` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.status.success.@` → `color.green.light.700` | `color.status.success.@` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.status.success.@` → `color.green.dark.700` |
| `badge/warning/background` | Warning badge fill. | `color.status.warning.subtle` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.status.warning.subtle` → `color.amber.light.100` | `color.status.warning.subtle` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.status.warning.subtle` → `color.amber.dark.100` |
| `badge/warning/label` | Warning badge label. | `color.status.warning.@` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.status.warning.@` → `color.amber.light.700` | `color.status.warning.@` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.status.warning.@` → `color.amber.dark.700` |
| `badge/danger/background` | Danger badge fill. | `color.status.danger.subtle` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.status.danger.subtle` → `color.red.light.100` | `color.status.danger.subtle` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.status.danger.subtle` → `color.red.dark.100` |
| `badge/danger/label` | Danger badge label. | `color.status.danger.@` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.status.danger.@` → `color.red.light.700` | `color.status.danger.@` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.status.danger.@` → `color.red.dark.700` |
